notes.title: Major Update : New NSFW mode & NSFW Models
notes.content:
[h1]New NSFW Filters & NSFW Models[/h1]

Toggles to enable NSFW mode for player and enemies are now available.
New Detailed NSFW enemy models and textures.

[h2]Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Toggles in Main Menu and Safe House Menu for enabling and disabling NSFW options.
[*]Fixed issue with translations not appearing properly.
[*]Loading speed optimized.
[*]Fixed issue where character falls through ground.
[*]Multiple gameplay optimizations
[*]Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
